propositions: The --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread CLI flags on _build-and-test.yml's shared-tier lanes permanently shadow ini changes carried in patchsets because pytest-timeout resolves flags (CLI precedence) at session start, preventing per-test-budget fixes from being exercised by their own Verified run.

Removing the explicit CLI --timeout and --timeout-method flags from both shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) and relying solely on [tool.pytest.ini_options] in pyproject.toml (timeout=300, timeout_method=thread) allows ini changes to be tested by their own gate run.
The effective timeout budget remains unchanged (300s, thread method) when moving authority from CLI flags to ini configuration, as the values are identical before and after the change.

The conftest-floor hardening mechanism (branch preserve/timeout-floor-hardening) was rejected because pytest-timeout resolves config._env_timeout at session start read-only with no supported hook point and no OSS precedent.

The parity contract must be rewritten to assert the shared-tier lanes carry no --timeout or --timeout-method flags and that the ini carries positive timeout values with thread method as their only guard.
